name: MEERKAT
summary: Web terminal that scores tokens and wallets on Robinhood Chain 0-100 from public on-chain evidence.
description: MEERKAT turns public on-chain data into transparent 0-100 token and wallet scores with a stated confidence and explains every point through origin, wallet, relationship, fee-flow and lifecycle evidence. A public terminal runs against a local index - 741,643 indexed events shown for one sample token - and the same open-source stack can be run locally with your own database.
contains: 0-100 token and wallet scores with confidence level
five evidence views: origin, wallets, relationships, fee flow, lifecycle
741,643 indexed events and 29 curve participants for one sample token
public terminal plus a locally runnable open-source stack
11-item field log with live, building, next and planned statuses
